messages:
maria: Hey team — escalating a customer issue. They hit a parser error after we routed to the fallback variant. Starts with normal /v1/generate JSON mode, but the fallback wraps the expected JSON payload inside a string field. Customer request attached.

maria: Customer report: \"Our parser fails with JSONDecodeError because the response body has a top-level field \u2018data\u2019 which is a string containing JSON, e.g. {\"data\": \"[{\\\"id\\\":1}]\"}\". Happens intermittently when traffic goes to the fallback model.

devon: @maria can you paste the raw API response you captured? Also which model variants are in the routing policy?

maria: Pasted below (sanitized). Primary variant: redwood-2026-std, fallback variant: redwood-2026-quant-gpu (quantized).

maria: ```http
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  \"input\": \"list recent orders\",
  \"response_format\": \"json\"
}
```

maria: Actual response when served by primary model (working):
```json
{"items": [{"id": 1, "status": "shipped"}], "meta": {"model": "redwood-2026-std"}}
```

maria: Actual response when routed to fallback variant (breaking):
```json
{ "data": "[{\"id\":1, \"status\":\"shipped\"}]", "meta": {"model": "redwood-2026-quant-gpu"} }
```

maria: Customer parser expects top-level array/object, not a JSON-in-a-string. They get JSONDecodeError in their consumer.

lee: Ugh, looks like the fallback model emits the same content but serializes it as a string literal. Likely a generation/regression in the quantized variant's output formatter.

devon: Can you repro locally with the same model pins and routing disabled? i.e., call the fallback variant directly to confirm?

maria: I did. Direct call to redwood-2026-quant-gpu reproduces the string-wrapped payload. Example below.

maria: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/redwood-2026-quant-gpu/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"input":"list recent orders","response_format":"json"}'
```

maria: Response: same as above with \"data\" string.

devon: Thanks. Severity? Customer says their pipeline is blocked for bulk ingestion.

maria: High — they process thousands of rows. Failing now.

lee: Oncall: tagging @oncall-bot. We should create an incident and escalate to eng-runtime/eng-ml. Short-term mitigation: advise customer to post-process by unwrapping the string (JSON.parse on the value) or pin to primary model until we fix. Also add a warning to smart-routing docs about possible fallback format differences.

oncall-bot: INC-2026-451 created for fallback variant regression. Assigned to eng-runtime. ETA triage in 30m.

devon: For eng-ml: looks like format post-processing step got lost when we quantized the model. Could be a tokenizer/detokenization edge where the model emits an extra quote. Requesting logs for the generator postprocessor for redwood-2026-quant-gpu for last 2 hours.

maria: I've added the customer's raw trace + request IDs in the incident. Also included their SDK version and example consumer parser stacktrace.

lee: Quick check: any chance the fallback is returning content-type text/plain? That would explain SDK treating it as string.

maria: No, response Content-Type is application/json in both cases. The body itself contains a string value.

devon: Good. Repro steps for eng: 1) direct call to quantized model with response_format=json 2) inspect raw body 3) check model postprocessor that maps internal dict -> JSON string.

maria: Customer mitigation instructions sent: 1) pin to redwood-2026-std 2) temporary client-side unwrap if urgent 3) we'll follow up once incident has root cause.

lee: Will add a unit/regression test to ensure all variants emit native JSON when response_format=json. Also add a schema enforcement layer at routing that validates final response against the expected schema and rejects/flags variant outputs that don't match.

devon: Thanks. Keeping thread updated with triage notes. :thumbsup:

maria: Updating customer that incident created. Will post root cause and patch once available.

oncall-bot: INC-2026-451 severity set to P1. Paging eng-runtime and eng-ml.

maria: Closing loop here when we have a fix; for now advise customers to pin models or unwrap string.
